response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.throws,'missing') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.throws,'missing')), s AS (SELECT hand, cnt, cnt*1.0/(SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM t) AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS combined_tally, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
